summary.text: Johnny Shaw is a Democratic state representative from Bolivar representing Tennessee House District 80 (part of Hardeman, Haywood and Madison Counties), a member of the 102nd through 114th General Assemblies. He is a businessman and minister who serves on the Fiscal Review and Ethics committees.

paragraphs.text: Shaw was born in Laconia, Tennessee, and studied theology at American Baptist College.
He is married and has five children.
He is a former Hardeman County commissioner and a former board member of the National Civil Rights Museum, and he is a lifetime member of the NAACP.
In 2020 the Hardeman County Commission named Highway 64 the Rep. Johnny W. Shaw Highway.
